alternative_explanations: A gain may be ordinary nearest-example memorization or implicit clustering by anonymous support shape rather than reusable fragment composition; the independent dictionary and native suites separate these accounts.
confounds: Freeze dictionary capacity 48, squared Euclidean distance, top-k 3 and weight 1/(distance+1e-6). The only intended change from EXP-0048 is the readout; changing recurrent width, transition, token encoding, evaluator, training seeds, family access, state cap or any retrieval constant invalidates the causal comparison.
falsification_criteria: Discard this exact capacity-48, squared-Euclidean, top-3 inverse-distance component-voting implementation without tuning if overall transfer is below 0.95, any family mean is below 0.90, or shared fitting fails to exceed the source-identical independent dictionary by 0.05 on both overall and minimum-family accuracy.
Discard the transfer claim if any registered native suite Pareto-dominates shared quality and every declared full-cost axis.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash rejects only implementation; semantic baseline failure, leakage, hash change, state breach or any encoder/retrieval-contract change invalidates the cohort and forbids interpretation.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null makes the recurrent-state route dormant with stronger evidence that the state, not merely the linear decoder, is inadequate; do not tune dictionary capacity, distance, top-k or weights.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed success revives HYP-0019 only to proposed status and authorizes a preregistered three-seed adversarial replication, never promotion.

predicted_outcome: The fixed 48-entry top-3 dictionary may remove EXP-0048's linear-decoder bottleneck and raise transfer materially, but shared accuracy will probably remain below 0.95 or collapse in one family; a valid full-threshold result would authorize replication only.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; authorize only a three-seed adversarial screen if all capability, sharing, state and full-cost Pareto gates pass with intact semantic baselines and integrity.
research_question: Does replacing only EXP-0048's linear template readout with a fixed family-blind dictionary of at most 48 recurrent input-output fragments, squared-Euclidean top-3 retrieval and inverse-distance component voting allow the unchanged width-32 state transition to transfer across four unseen world families better than the source-identical independently fitted dictionary and registered native specialists?
title: Fixed 48-fragment predictive dictionary readout

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any derived training and scoring seed collision.
Invalidate if the shared candidate receives a family label or privileged native object.
Invalidate if any training or test value is truncated, sampled or encoded by a family-specific rule.
Invalidate if test results, targets or oracle fields are available during pooled meta-fit.
Invalidate on candidate tuning after any scoring output is observed.
Invalidate if the shared source dispatches on family, native type, slot identity or a hand-written ontology.
